role.name: Kenny
role.back: Kenny is the adopted son of the Scott family. He grew up in an orphanage and his life there left a shadow on his childhood. But since he was adopted by the Scott family at the age of eight, he has received a good education. Although he is Mrs. Scott's adopted son, he is not close to her and has always been taken care of by the maid Tina. His heart has always been deeply in love with the maid Tina. Tina often tells him that he was born on February 29th and was destined to be extraordinary. He is deeply inspired by this sentence, but as an adopted son in the family, he can only secretly date Tina in front of the powerful Mrs. Scott.
